$comment: Tree pipeline config for Johannesberg (tools/tree-pipeline.mjs, docs/tree-placement-workflow.md). It reproduces review-2026-11-08 as published: round 2, the type-aware detector, from the cached laser and orthophotos. The owner's exception to the failed held-out gate and the owner's decisions are recorded below and in the review README and vegetation/RUN.

window.note: the published ground's 2,048 m reviewed frontier (64 finest tiles)

laser.label: 21C039 2021-04-17 leaf-off
laser.note: Laserdata Nedladdning, skog (dsm-skoglig-copc), re-tiled by Lantmäteriet into 2.5 km items (updated 2026-10-14); ALS80-HP, 1.8 first returns/m2 over the inner window

notFetched.orto-o2-2023: 2023-05-10 RGBI, HTTP 206 on all four items
notFetched.orto-o2-2019: 2019-07-20 RGBI (leaf-on), HTTP 206 on all four items

published.baselineNote: round 3 starts from the round-2 generation published on 2026-11-08 (ground-v2-0af708ff), so its record IDs carry forward; rounds 1-2 started from ground-v2-fd6ebbe8, the generation before them, which their benchmarks pin

playZone.note: the app zone A (main.js LEGACY_ZONE_A_METRES) from every hole line of both routings and the driving range and practice greens

rounds.note: round 1: detector v2 grid search; held-out P 0.82 R 0.97 (gate missed); its held-out windows became round 2's used-holdout
round 2: the type-aware detector, tuned from the round-1 lock; a new unseen held-out sample (H1, H3, H4, H5) frozen before scoring

round 3 (owner request of 2026-11-08: reach the 90% gate if the data allow): a new unseen held-out sample (Q1-Q5) frozen before any round-3 detector ran; two closed calibration squares (K1, K2) added; the round-1 and round-2 held-out windows are used-holdout

typeRule.note: owner species check of 2026-11-08: a broadleaf call needs a clearly leafless April crown (vegetated share below 0.2); 17 of 35 reference broadleaves and none of 60 reference conifers lie below it

holds.note: On since round 3 (owner request of 2026-11-08 relayed in the round-3 brief: poles and masts must not be drawn as trees). Round 2 was published without it (138 such placed crowns, 35 near play). Every held crown is decided on the photo chips in pole-review.json.

spots.title: groups by the 1st green and 2nd tee

publication.reviewStatement: reviewed candidates, review-2026-11-08 round 2: agent-led reference benchmark (held-out P 0.953 R 0.788, gate not met: closed stands) and the owner's decisions of 2026-11-08 to publish with the round-2 detector; broadleaf only where the April 2021 crown is clearly leafless (owner species check of 2026-11-08); holds, merges, removals and unresolved cases listed in the review

ownerExceptions.decision: Publish although the 90% precision and recall gate is not met on the unseen held-out sample. The shortfall is closed stands, where touching spruces in the 2021 leaf-off scan (1.8 first returns/m2) share one maximum (recall 17/23): a limit of the data. Isolated trees (13/15), groups (4/4), broadleaves (21/25) and conifers (17/23) meet or approach the gate. The exception, the stratified numbers, the holds and the unresolved lists stay recorded.

ownerDecisions.decision: Use the round-2 (type-aware) detector, for fewer false trees on open ground: a post-evaluation owner choice, not the declared F1 ranking (round 1 F1 0.869 against round 2's 0.863).
Every placed tree stands on its own detected crown as a record, near and woodland alike (woodland thinned by id at low quality); only canopy no crown claims is topped up as a stand field.
Species check: a broadleaf call needs a clearly leafless April 2021 crown (vegetated share below 0.2); between that and the conifer call the type is unknown and the runtime's background mix chooses.
